claims: The Houston Astros opened the 2026 MLB season against the Los Angeles Angels.
The Houston Astros' 2026 season opening game was on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
The Houston Astros' 2026 season opening game was at Daikin Park in Houston, TX.
The Houston Astros' 2026 season opening game began at 3:10 p.m. CST.
The Houston Astros' 2026 season opening game was broadcast on Space City Home Network.
The Houston Astros' 2026 season opening game was streamed via Peacock and other platforms.
A street fest was scheduled to precede the Houston Astros' 2026 season opening game.
The Houston Astros faced the Los Angeles Angels for their opening series at home.
Other major sports events like the NCAA Tournament occurred simultaneously with the Houston Astros opening series.
